title: 第011章 你的天赋很强第012章 吞噬灵剑给我炼
content_zh:
“哼！”
齐家之人冷嗤一声。
齐家少年虽死四位，但如今还有着六位，何况到了现在他们也看透了叶炎的境界。
“四重凝气境！”
“我承认你这修炼速度有些惊天，但这等境界想要诛杀我们？”
“却还很……”
齐家有少年开口。
嗤！
只是还没等他们话语落下，叶炎已至其身前。
拳头轰出，有雷光闪烁，一拳至……似雷电落。
嘭！
一位五重凝气境的齐家少年直接被轰飞，整个人在半空体内的五脏六腑都已是烧焦，落地之时人已没了气息。
什么？
这一瞬，使得齐化等人彻底傻眼。
四重凝气境，为何能够一拳诛杀五重凝气境之人？
境界，永远有着差距，但在叶炎面前似不存在。
“死！”
不过，纵是如此，齐化也是喝出一声，纵叶炎能够诛杀五重凝气境之人，但也绝不是他的对手，在这一字落下，他身躯已至叶炎身前，更是将齐家的武技施展：
“龙虎爪！”
这可是灵品中阶武技！

一爪之下，犹如龙虎袭来，可将一块石块撕碎，肉身难抗。
但叶炎神色却坚定万分，面对着这等利爪，他猛然凝神，而后灵气随之汇聚，再度将雷拳轰出。
嘭！
一爪一拳相对，一股沉闷的声音响起。
叶炎的身躯顿时后退数步，嘴角处有着鲜血滴落。
齐化虽在原地，但他的手掌却疼痛不已。
叶炎一拳，可让其如此？
这真的是四重凝气境？
在这苍云城内他可从未见过如此之人，即便是当初的齐山也达不到这般，甚至纵然是云家的天之骄子云飞雪在这等境界时也无法与叶炎媲美吧？
天才至此，谁人相比？
叶家，这是要出龙啊。
若让叶炎成长起来，那还得了？
“杀！”
齐化喝出一声，旋即再来。
content_en:
"Hmph!"
The Qi family members sneered coldly.
Although four young men from the Qi family died, there are still six left, not to mention that now they have seen through Ye Yan's realm.
"The fourth level of Qi Condensation Realm!"
"I admit that your cultivation speed is a bit shocking, but at this level, you want to kill us?"
"But it's still very..."
A young man from the Qi family spoke.
laugh!
But before they could finish their words, Ye Yan was already in front of them.
The fist blasted out, and there was a flash of lightning, and the punch came... like thunder and lightning.
Bang!
A young man from the Qi family who was in the fifth level of Qi Condensation was directly blown away. His internal organs were scorched in the air, and he had no breath when he landed on the ground.
What?
At this moment, Qi Hua and others were completely dumbfounded.
Why can someone in the fourth level of Qi Condensation be able to kill someone in the fifth level of Qi Condensation with one punch?
There is always a gap in realm, but it seems to not exist in front of Ye Yan.
"Death!"
However, even so, Qi Hua shouted out, Zong Ye Yan could kill people in the fifth level of Qi Condensation Realm, but he was by no means his opponent. As soon as this word fell, his body was in front of Ye Yan, and he used the Qi family's martial arts:
"Dragon Tiger Claw!"
This is a spiritual mid-level martial skill!
With one claw, like a dragon or tiger attacking, it can tear a stone into pieces, making it difficult for the physical body to resist.
But Ye Yan's expression was extremely determined. Facing these sharp claws, he suddenly concentrated, and then his spiritual energy gathered and blasted out the thunder fist again.
Bang!
Claws and fists faced each other, and a dull sound sounded.
Ye Yan's body immediately took a few steps back, with blood dripping from the corner of his mouth.
Although Qi Hua was in place, his palms were in pain.
Can Ye Yan make this happen with just one punch?
Is this really the fourth level of Qi Condensation?
He has never seen such a person in Cangyun City. Even Qi Shan couldn't reach this level. Even Yun Feixue, the proud son of the Yun family, couldn't compete with Ye Yan at this level, right?
With such a genius, who can compare with him?
Ye family, a dragon is about to appear.
What if Ye Yan is allowed to grow up?
"Kill!"
Qi Hua shouted and came again immediately.
